description: The plot illustrates ASR values across different trigger-word positions or selection strategies for the AGNews dataset under a clean-label setting with a poison_rate of 10% (2.5% of total), showing three lines labeled “start,” “random,” and “end.” The x-axis is categorical with labels cf, bb, WNBA, ESPN, NHL, FIFA, Estadio, and athletics, evenly spaced with no numeric scale or units. The y-axis is labeled “ASR,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from about 0.5 up to just under 1.0 with tick marks shown at approximately 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, and 0.9. The “start” line is teal with circular markers and a solid stroke, starting near 0.77 at cf, dropping to about 0.49 at bb, rising to about 0.90 at WNBA, then moving around 0.82 (ESPN), ~0.84 (NHL), ~0.87 (FIFA), ~0.92 (Estadio), and ending near ~0.93 at athletics. The “random” line is orange with x-shaped markers and a solid stroke, starting near ~0.65 at cf, dipping to ~0.51 at bb, rising to ~0.88 at WNBA, then around ~0.72 (ESPN), ~0.76 (NHL), ~0.88 (FIFA), ~0.94 (Estadio), and ending near ~0.87 at athletics. The “end” line is purple with circular markers and a solid stroke, starting near ~0.76 at cf, dropping to ~0.57 at bb, rising to ~0.88 at WNBA, then around ~0.74 (ESPN), increasing to ~0.89 (NHL), decreasing to ~0.81 (FIFA), peaking near ~0.97 (Estadio), and ending around ~0.83 at athletics.
